A digital 'ding' sound effect highlights the appearance of text. (2) A sharp 'whoosh' transition leads into a more atmospheric musical bed as the speaker's tone shifts to one of surprise and confusion, with audible gasps. (3) The tempo of the BGM increases as the speaker regains his high-energy tone. Every scene cut is accented by percussive hit sounds or whoosh effects. (4) As game footage appears, the audio track is layered with high-frequency 'pop' and 'magic' sound effects from the mobile game's interface. The speaker's voice is enunciated clearly and processed with standard studio compression. (5) The video concludes with the music swelling in volume and the speaker delivering a final, enthusiastic slogan over a celebratory synth chord.
